clues.title: Google car: Unique car
text: The entire Google car is blurred, however an antenna at the front right and a tiny part of the roof rack can be seen. You can confuse it with:
Puerto Rico(Cars there won't have front plates, signs will be Spanish).
Northern Mariana Islands(Antenna there will be noticeably closer to the camera but as long you will go Guam/NMI and not Puerto Rico you will get good score.

clues.title: Road Reflectors
text: Both Guam and Northern Mariana Islands often have a very large number of road reflectors.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Pole: Poles
text: Poles on Guam are almost always concrete and commonly very thick.
Northern Mariana Islands typically have wooden poles.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
